tasks.title: Add find_references to ReadOnlyFileTools and verify core invariants
steps: Write TS-18-1 and TS-18-2 in `internal/agentrun/policy_test.go`: TS-18-1 asserts `ReadOnlyFileTools` equals the seven-element slice `["read_file", "list_files", "find_files", "search_files", "file_outline", "find_symbol", "find_references"]` in that order; TS-18-2 asserts `find_references` is in neither `MutatingTools` nor `ShellTools` and `AssertReadOnly` returns nil for a set containing all seven. Confirm both fail.

In `internal/agentrun/policy.go`, append `"find_references"` to `ReadOnlyFileTools` after `"find_symbol"`. Update the comment above from 'neither writes' to include `find_references`. Update `TestTS15_1_ReadOnlyFileToolsHasTheSixReadTools` to expect seven entries (rename it to reflect seven, or let it coexist with TS-18-1). Confirm TS-18-1 and TS-18-2 pass.

Write TS-18-3 in `internal/agentrun/phase_test.go`: build a `Runner` with a faux provider and a workspace, run a read-only phase with `BuiltinTools: ReadOnlyFileTools`, and assert the model request's declared tools include `find_references` and every other ReadOnlyFileTools entry. Confirm it passes.

Write TS-18-4 in `internal/agentrun/phase_test.go`: call `registeredTools` twice with separate Phase values (both using ReadOnlyFileTools), and assert both returned tool sets include `find_references` and that the two slices are distinct objects. Confirm it passes.

Write TS-18-8 in `internal/agentrun/phase_test.go`: call `toolsNote` with a tool set that includes `find_references` and assert the returned string contains `find_references` in the sorted tool list. Write TS-18-9: call `toolsNote` with a `find_references` tool carrying a non-empty `PromptGuidelines` slice, and assert the result contains `Tool guidelines:` and the guideline text as a bullet. Confirm both pass.

Write TS-18-15, TS-18-16 and TS-18-21 in `internal/agentrun/policy_test.go`: TS-18-15 asserts `WithCodeSearch(ReadOnlyFileTools, true)` returns a new slice of length 8 ending with `code_search` without mutating the original (compare `len` before and after, mutate result[0] and confirm original is unchanged); TS-18-16 asserts `WithCodeSearch(ReadOnlyFileTools, false)` returns the same length with no `code_search`; TS-18-21 is a property test that loops grant lengths 0..20, calling `WithCodeSearch(grant, true)` and asserting the original slice's length and contents are unchanged and the result has length original+1 ending with `code_search`. Confirm all pass.
Run `make check` to confirm all new and existing tests pass and the linter is clean.
